corpus.why_this_project: A real, mature GPL-2.0 game with a large keyed string table (4721 StringIDs) and source references spread across C++, INI settings templates and base-set metadata. It exercises exact-token, macro, settings-range and computed-StringID retrieval in one pinned checkout, and its translated tables let us test leakage denial.
corpus.not_vendored: The corpus is downloaded into .corpus/ (gitignored). This repository stores only short evidence quotations with path:line attribution.
